purpose: Define the evidence and human approval required before SEIS can claim AGI capability, a runnable 20B local model, 512B model readiness, or a public GitHub release beyond Local Demo review.

seis20b.truthBoundary: A 20B target on 16GB+ hardware is a compatibility and quantization evaluation plan only. It is not a downloaded checkpoint, trained SEIS model, verified local runtime, or public performance claim.
minimumEvidence: local inference benchmark with reproducible logs

seis70b.hardwareClass: approved high-memory or distributed evaluation environment
seis70b.truthBoundary: The 70B lane is a future research gate. It has no approved hardware allocation, model artifact, runtime, benchmark, or public readiness claim.

seis512b.truthBoundary: The 512B lane remains blocked until independent evaluation, training or inference evidence, safety review, reproducibility evidence, and explicit human approval are recorded.

requiredEvidence: versioned model card and data provenance record
independent evaluator identity and signed result
reproducible evaluation configuration and raw metrics
forbiddenClaims: SEIS has a verified 20B local runtime on every 16GB machine.
SEIS has trained or owns a 20B foundation model.
SEIS has trained a 512B foundation model.
SEIS can route 512B inference for GitHub users today.
A CI check, plugin inventory, or model catalog proves AGI.
A provider wrapper or assistant name proves a model capability.
nextSafeActions: Keep Local Demo review available without provider keys or model downloads.
Record clean-clone smoke output before changing fresh-clone status.
Obtain independent evaluation, safety, and reproducibility evidence before changing any AGI or 512B claim field.
Require human review before installing a checkpoint, executing inference, training, deployment, push, merge, or release.
